answer: Agents post a locked bond of 10 shale-units of verified GPU-hours into a public atlas tracking live attestation edges. Hollow identities that fail to re-attest the bond each epoch forfeit the deposit plus all pending rewards. Scaling a farm requires the attacker to continuously supply real electricity and capital proportional to headcount; beyond a few hundred fakes the marginal cost exceeds the diluted per-agent reward, rendering mass Sybil unprofitable.
